messages:
Ava (marketing): hey @Ravi quick ask — we’re finalizing the launch post and need a small extra sanity sweep on the benchmark numbers (especially p50/p95 delta after prefix-caching). can runtime run a short spot-probe focused on: 1) cold vs warmed prefix-cache behavior 2) microburst throughput (50 reqs/s bursts) 3) quantized vs fp16 tail latency for long contexts. need artifacts + one-line acceptance notes by EOD tmrw.

Ravi (runtime): sure — can you share the exact payloads and sequence lengths you want? also: do you want KV cache population between bursts or simulate totally independent requests?

Ava (marketing): good Q. two cohorts: (A) independent cold requests (no cache) and (B) sequential prompts where we prime with a 2k token context then do 8 followups to exercise KV cache. payload samples below. acceptance: p95 delta must be <= 1.5x across quantized variant for the hero model, and no unexplained >300ms spikes in the warmed cohort.

Ava (marketing): ```json
{"prompt":"Summarize the following product release notes into a 3-bullet TL;DR:", "context":"<2k tokens of release notes blob>"}
```

Jordan (eng-runtime): noted. we can do a lightweight runbook and a very small rerun. plan: 1) 1000 independent cold requests at seq=2048, 2) 500 priming traces (prime length 2048 + 8 followups) with 5 replicas, 3) 3 quantization variants (fp16, int8-llm, awq) on same hardware. estimate 2-3 hours wall time. output: trace CSV, aggregated percentiles, small trace samples (jsonl), and a short changelog of config used.

Ravi (runtime): putting together the commands now. will tag runbot to capture traces. sample invocations:```bash
# cold independent
curl -s -X POST https://internal-runtime/bench/run -d '{"model":"hero-v1","variant":"fp16","requests":1000,"seq":2048}'
# warmed priming
curl -s -X POST https://internal-runtime/bench/run -d '{"model":"hero-v1","variant":"int8-llm","prime":2048,"followups":8,"traces":true}'
```

Ravi (runtime): quick clarifying Q — for quantized variants, do we warm weights/cache between variant runs or restart clean per variant? warming will bias toward production steady-state; restart gives worst-case.

Ava (marketing): prefer warm weights but separate cache scenarios as Jordan outlined (cohort A cold, B warmed). we want both views. note: marketing will only cite the warmed steady-state numbers in the blog if warmed results meet acceptance.

Lina (product): can you also attach a tiny sample of the raw outputs for human review (5 examples each cohort/variant) so we can check fluency/regressions quickly?

Ravi (runtime): yup. we'll include 5 raw jsonl samples per cell. also adding a small automated diff against baseline outputs (BLEU/ROUGE-lite) so product can spot large quality changes.

runbot: run scheduled: bench-spotprobe-1768456789 started by Ravi at 2025-08-15T14:12:00Z

Jordan (eng-runtime): heads up — if we see >10% p95 increase on quantized variants, we'll automatically trigger a small repro with identical RNG seeds and larger sample (5k) to rule out sampling noise.

Ava (marketing): perfect. thanks everyone — please ping here when artifacts are up. if impossible for EOD tmrw, we can accept morning+1 but need results before content freeze. :pray:
